content: The third block shows two word expert traditional supervised systems. IMS BIBREF7 is a flexible framework which trains SVM classifiers and uses local features. And IMS$_{+emb}$ BIBREF9 is the best configuration of the IMS framework, which also integrates word embeddings as features.
